title: Quiver Hecke--Clifford superalgebras and R-matrices
summary: In this paper, we develop the foundations of the representation theory of quiver Hecke--Clifford superalgebras. We further construct a Schur--Weyl duality between quantum affine analogues of the queer Lie superalgebra and the quiver Hecke--Clifford superalgebra of type A, based on the construction due to Kwon--Lee.
